summary: Concept index at /read/concepts: domain→family→concept browse page
description: The 110 concept constellation pages shipped in PR #106 are only reachable through chunk-page tag chips — there is no index. Add /read/concepts: a browse page over the domain→family→concept hierarchy (api/hierarchy and the concept_families tables already expose it), each entry linking to its constellation page with passage counts. Makes the concept layer a first-class entrance to the library and adds a strong landing page; add it to the sitemap alongside the 110 concept URLs already listed.
